items.title: AstraZeneca Ends Phase 3 Lung Cancer Drug Trial After Review
items.content_text: A committee said the volrustomig combination was unlikely to reach either of the primary endpoints for the trial, but the company said other Phase 3 volrustomig trials would continue as planned.

items.title: AstraZeneca Says Lung-Disease Drug Shows Benefits Across Patient Groups
items.content_text: AstraZeneca said its new drug for COPD showed benefits across a broad patient population in late-stage clinical trials, boosting a medicine the company expects to generate multibillion-dollar sales.

items.title: Novartis shares dropped as much as 10% after the drugmaker said an experimental neuromuscular treatment failed a late-stage clinical trial
items.content_text: The failure of a neuromuscular treatment is a blow to the drugmaker’s efforts to revive its growth prospects.

items.title: Novo Nordisk Says Wegovy Shot Helped Children Lose Weight in Trial
items.content_text: The Danish drugmaker said the clinical trial met its primary goal after 68 weeks of treatment.

items.title: Novartis Shares Fall After Heart Drug Misses Target in Late-Stage Trial
items.content_text: The company said the late-stage study for its pelacarsen drug missed its primary objective of reducing the risk of cardiovascular events like death, heart attack and stroke compared with placebo.

items.title: Patients are flying to Shanghai hospitals for pioneering cancer treatments that cost more in the West
items.content_text: Shanghai is emerging as a favored destination for patients from America and other rich countries who are seeking innovations in biotechnology.
